9. At 1529 hours i.e. ten minutes after my arrival, Divisional Officer LAM Ho-chun (“DO LAM”) took on the role of Incident Commander.

10. At about 1532, I met and reported to DO LAM the situation of the incident, and I was instructed by him to continue my firefighting operations at Wang Kin House and Wang Sun House.

[Question 9(d)]
